authority: PI, 2026-09-05: GO RUNG 1. Build the shared-CNN / separate-everything-else model, train it with the frozen 20-epoch distillation recipe on the same 35,005 rows, freeze the terminal checkpoint, evaluate it against the 128 matched Rung-0 seeds.
rule: APPEND. Recipe, gate, device, training seed (11961001) and the matched-evaluation rule are unchanged.
THE_QUESTION: What happens if the two strategies share ONLY the CNN encoder?

CONSTRUCTION.branches: two complete, independently initialised actors of the SPECIALISTS' own architecture (custom_ppo_cnn_v1, 20 parameters each: actor_cnn.*, latent_actor.body.*, latent_actor.action_head.* [macro+target logits, 55 per agent], critic.*). z0 -> branch z0, z1 -> branch z1.
CONSTRUCTION.why_the_specialist_architecture_per_bran: each branch then has exactly the capacity of the teacher it imitates, so a Rung-1 loss cannot be attributed to a smaller per-strategy network. The ONLY thing changed relative to Rung 0 is that the two branches share one CNN encoder.
CONSTRUCTION.sharing: the z1 branch's actor_cnn module is REPLACED by the z0 branch's actor_cnn module object (parameter tying by identity). Verified at preflight by (a) module identity and (b) unique-parameter arithmetic: total unique parameters == n_cnn + 2 * (n_branch - n_cnn).
kept_separate: action heads incl. macro AND target logits (latent_actor.action_head)
CONSTRUCTION.per_row_dispatch_in_training: policy_logits(obs, z_idx) computes both branches' logits on the batch and selects per row by z_idx, so a mixed-z minibatch trains both branches and the shared encoder receives gradient from BOTH strategies in the same step -- that shared gradient is precisely the phenomenon the rung exists to test.
CONSTRUCTION.initialisation: fresh random init, torch.manual_seed(11961001) for branch z0 and 11961002 for branch z1; verified to differ from the specialists' weights (not a silent warm start)

TRAINING_RECIPE_UNCHANGED.loss: 0.5*KL(pi_A||branch_z0) + 0.5*KL(pi_B||branch_z1), both teachers on the SAME states, decision-boundary mask
TRAINING_RECIPE_UNCHANGED.data: TEACHER_DISTILLATION_DATASET.json, 31,714 train / 3,291 holdout rows, stratified by state-origin pole
TRAINING_RECIPE_UNCHANGED.schedule: 20 fixed epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 3e-4, clip 1.0, no early stopping, no checkpoint selection, terminal weights only
TRAINING_RECIPE_UNCHANGED.optimised: actor parameters = shared encoder + both private bodies/heads; critics excluded and verified immobile
TRAINING_RECIPE_UNCHANGED.fit_check: teacher-holdout agreement >= 0.50 for both z before the matched eval opens

PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED_8_CHECKS: teacher dataset loads; both poles; holdout non-empty
each branch's parameter names/shapes match the specialist architecture exactly, and fresh weights differ from pi_A
encoder is shared: branch_z0.actor_cnn IS branch_z1.actor_cnn, and unique-parameter count == n_cnn + 2*(n_branch - n_cnn)
teacher self-KL exactly 0 through the same masked-head path
after one backward on a mixed-z batch: nonzero gradient on the SHARED encoder, nonzero on BOTH private stacks, NONE on any critic
one optimizer step moves shared encoder and both private stacks; every critic parameter bit-identical
save/load round-trip reproduces masked logits exactly for both z

EVALUATION.rule: LADDER_MATCHED_EVALUATION_AMENDMENT.json -- the 128 matched seeds in RUNG0_LADDER_REFERENCE.json, four cells, cuda
EVALUATION.inference_path: each branch wrapped in CustomPPOInferencePolicy exactly as the specialists are, then dispatched by z through the Rung-0 wrapper class already verified bit-exact -- so the evaluator exercises the identical code path Rung 0 used; only what sits behind predict() differs
EVALUATION.PRIMARY: within-seed D_A, D_B vs the frozen Rung-0 per-seed deltas; 'sharing damaged specialization' iff UCB95(D) < 0 on a pole

SEEDS.eval: the 128 matched seeds; no new eval seeds
SEEDS.disjointness: 1196xxxx confirmed unused before the ladder spec was committed; the eval seeds are Rung 0's, by design

SEQUENCE: freeze this record -> build -> preflight 8/8 -> train 20 epochs -> fit check -> freeze checkpoint (sha) -> matched 128-seed eval on cuda, GPU otherwise clear -> read D first, own gate second
